bullets.text: Netflix Dominates Streaming - **Netflix** remains the top choice for streaming with a vast library and user-friendly interface.
Apple Arcade Needs Improvements - A new feature request for **Apple Arcade** could enhance user experience for game downloads.
FDA Approves Medical Imaging Feature - **Apple's** Studio Display XDR now has FDA clearance for medical imaging use.
Google Maps Enhances User Contributions - New AI features in **Google Maps** simplify photo contributions and captioning.
Vertical Tabs Finally in Chrome - **Google Chrome** introduces vertical tabs, improving user experience for managing multiple tabs.
Uber Chooses Amazon's AI Chips - **Uber** expands its use of **AWS** chips for enhanced ride-sharing features.
Iranian Hackers Target Infrastructure - U.S. agencies warn of Iranian hackers attacking critical infrastructure systems.
New AI Model for Cybersecurity - **Anthropic** launches a powerful AI model to help identify software vulnerabilities.
Apple's Foldable iPhone Launch - **Apple** is set to release its first foldable iPhone in September 2026.
Google Data Settlement Now Live - Users can claim from the **Google** data settlement regarding unauthorized data transfers.
